summary: <cite index="4-3,22-14">Bitcoin surged to $77,692 this week, notching its best five-day performance since March 2024, after President Trump met with crypto executives and urged Congress to pass the CLARITY Act</cite>. <cite index="20-8,22-16">The rally accelerated when Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced plans to double long-term bond buyback limits, injecting liquidity into markets and suppressing yields</cite>. <cite index="24-7,24-21">Spot Bitcoin ETFs pulled in roughly $307 million on August 21, while Ethereum ETFs received about $184 million, capping weekly inflows of $1.9 billion and $697 million respectively</cite>. Equity markets posted modest Friday gains to close a volatile week, with <cite index="4-1,4-4">the Dow climbing about 1% and the S&P 500 adding 0.4%</cite>. <cite index="4-6">Despite Friday's bounce, the major indexes all posted weekly losses after a bond sell-off put pressure on risk assets</cite>. <cite index="17-12,17-13">At its July meeting, the Federal Reserve held rates steady at 3.5% to 3.75%, though three FOMC members dissented in favor of a hike</cite>. <cite index="7-10">Next week brings the July PCE price index on Wednesday along with Nvidia earnings, key tests for market sentiment</cite>.

signals.title: Trump pushes CLARITY Act, Bitcoin ETFs see record inflows
signals.desc: Bitcoin surged 22% this week to $77,692 after Trump backed crypto legislation and spot Bitcoin ETFs pulled in $1.9 billion in weekly inflows, signaling institutional demand.

signals.title: Treasury doubles bond buyback limit, suppresses yields
signals.desc: Treasury Secretary Bessent's announcement to double long-term debt buybacks injected liquidity and lowered yields, boosting appetite for risk assets including crypto and equities.

signals.title: Weekend crypto liquidations hit $109 million despite ETF demand
signals.desc: Bitcoin and Ethereum saw $109.66 million in combined liquidations over the weekend, 80% from longs, as crowded positioning and thin liquidity triggered forced selling.

signals.title: Bond yields rebound, equities post weekly losses
signals.desc: Major stock indexes posted weekly losses despite Friday's gains as Treasury yields rebounded from intervention lows, pressuring tech and growth sectors.

signals.title: Fed minutes show three dissenters wanted July rate hike
signals.desc: FOMC minutes revealed three members dissented in favor of raising rates at the July meeting, signaling divisions over inflation risks as markets await next week's PCE data.

verdict: Crypto rallies on Trump's CLARITY Act push and Treasury liquidity injection, but weekend leverage flush and Fed dissent cloud near-term risk appetite ahead of Nvidia and PCE.
